blocks.text: BONGABONG, ORIENTAL MINDORO — Before she became a teacher, Gloria Lintawagin Reyes knew what it was like to enter a classroom carrying not only her schoolbooks but also the full weight of being Mangyan. “I was born into a simple family. My parents were unable to attend school. Because of our difficult circumstances, I dreamed of finishing my education and becoming a teacher someday so I could have a good job,” said Gloria, 36, in a recent interview.
